infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the OLI logistics department office on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: OLI logistics department office key (OLI Log.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the OLI logistics department office at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Required for the quest A Big Loss from Ragman

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Inside the trunk of the blue car, Right beside the shortcut between the Factory area of Customs and the new Gas Station.
